title: 第2325章 黑色祭坛第2324章 九颗帝星
slug: 刚穿越就继承了宗主之位
lines: 秦叶仰头望去，神色平淡，但是没有一点惧意。
“来得好！”
秦叶脚踏虚空，周身金光暴涨，整个人如同一轮金色太阳，挡住了朝他镇压而来的那只巨掌。
天地变色。
两人激烈对抗产生的冲击波，以两人碰撞的地方为中心向四周扩散，即便两人已经战斗到了半空，但是山谷的岩壁还是被崩碎，无数巨石如雨点般坠落。
躲到百里开外的众人也被这股冲击波震得东倒西歪，修为低的直接口吐鲜血。
也幸好，他们躲的距离有些远，否则只怕就不只是吐血那么简单了。
“嘶，这小子怎么这么厉害？！”
“还要再往后退，这里已经不安全了。”
“该死，真是神仙打架，凡人遭殃！”
众人只好再次后退，但是却没有一个人舍得离开，他们都瞪大了眼睛，死死的盯着打斗的两人。
他们都好奇，这个年轻人与这具死尸到底谁更厉害。
“你确实有些厉害，不过这一切该结束了。”
白底冷冷地说道。
白帝这次彻底的疯狂了，直接操控九颗帝星向着秦叶砸了下来。
他要以九颗帝星的力量，直接将秦叶灭掉。
秦叶来不及反应，九颗帝星砸落了下来，爆发出巨大的轰鸣声。
众人瞪大了眼睛，死死地盯着这个方向。
当烟尘散去，众人才看到半空中的景象。
秦叶身上金色光芒暗淡了大半，嘴角更是溢出一丝鲜血。
只是看秦叶这样子，虽然受了伤，但是依然有一战之力。
两人在半空中继续对峙。
“你……你的确有点本事。”
白帝微微皱眉，他没有想到秦叶比他想象中还要强大一些。
即便是武帝，也绝对扛不住他这一击。
但是，秦叶也只是受了一点伤，他这肉身太恐怖。
秦叶淡淡一笑，倒是没有说话。
content_en:
Qin Ye looked up with a calm expression, but without any fear.
"Well done!"
Qin Ye stepped into the void, and the golden light around him surged. His whole body was like a golden sun, blocking the giant palm that was coming to suppress him.
"Boom——"
The sky and the earth change color.
The shock wave generated by the fierce confrontation between the two spread out around the place where the two collided. Even though the two had fought in mid-air, the rock walls of the valley were still shattered, and countless boulders fell like raindrops.
Everyone who was hiding hundreds of miles away was also shaken by the shock wave, and those with low cultivation levels vomited blood.
Fortunately, they were hiding far away, otherwise it would have been more than just vomiting blood.
"Hey, why is this kid so powerful?!"
"We have to go back further, it's no longer safe here."
"Damn it, it's really a fight between gods and mortals!"
Everyone had no choice but to retreat again, but no one was willing to leave. They all stared at the two fighting men with their eyes wide open.
They were all curious about who was more powerful, this young man or this corpse.
"You are indeed a bit powerful, but it's time for this to end."
Bai Di said coldly.
"Destroy!"
Bai Di went completely crazy this time and directly controlled the nine emperor stars to smash down on Qin Ye.
He wanted to use the power of the nine emperor stars to directly destroy Qin Ye.
"Boom——"
Qin Ye had no time to react, and nine emperor stars fell down, erupting with a huge roar.
Everyone's eyes widened and they stared in this direction.
When the smoke and dust dispersed, everyone saw the scene in mid-air.
The golden light on Qin Ye's body dimmed by half, and a trace of blood overflowed from the corner of his mouth.
Just looking at Qin Ye like this, even though he was injured, he was still capable of fighting.
The two continued to confront each other in mid-air.
"You...you do have some abilities."
Bai Di frowned slightly. He didn't expect Qin Ye to be stronger than he thought.
Even Emperor Wu would never be able to withstand his attack.
However, Qin Ye was only slightly injured, and his physical body was too terrifying.
Qin Ye smiled faintly but said nothing.
